description: node:test suite: Node's own test runner over the files named. Tests are discovered by filename glob, either as siblings under the area's own paths or under a central root whose filename stem matches a changed source file.

project_dir.description: The directory the tests resolve their imports from, relative to the repository root. Defaults to ".".

root.description: Directory under which the "filename" strategy looks for centralized tests, and the whole suite is found. Defaults to ".".

glob.description: Filename glob(s) identifying this suite's test files: a single pattern or an array of patterns whose matches are unioned. Defaults to "*.test.js".

exclude.description: Filename glob(s) to drop from the matched test files: a single pattern or an array of patterns.
